label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Understand Your Competition
body: Competitor analysis is looking at what other businesses in your space are doing online to help you find opportunities and make informed decisions for your own work.
caption:
When you check out what similar creators or sellers are offering, how they price things, and how they talk to their audience, you can spot gaps or new ideas for your own products or services. It's not about copying, but about learning and finding your unique edge so you can stand out and serve your audience even better. This helps you refine your approach.
